svg.title: Proved Zero-Free Region
svg.desc: Selected explicit benchmark families, not an exhaustive world-record comparison. External analytic proofs are not imported into the Lean union. Left: zero-free width versus log-height. Right: regions shaded toward sigma=1, our independently proved complete region in coral. It extends beyond the combined benchmark widths in the gray Lean-checked interval. Dashed external curves are reported or unresolved. Eventual regions with unevaluated starting heights, including our own log-log component, have no certified finite plotting start and are not drawn. The external finite RH verification to height 3e12 is not imported; this plot compares explicit analytic edge-width families, not every known zero-location result. Older or supplementary benchmark formulas and all edge conventions remain in the linked literature-frontier table.
